resolved.title: 列完全限定名
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Fully Qualified Names[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

In SQL, you can provide the table name prior to the column name, by separating them with a [b]dot[/b].
[s0l0!-header][b]The following statements are equivalent:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" ]SELECT City FROM customers;

SELECT [b]customers.[/b]City FROM customers;[/code]
The term for the above-mentioned syntax is called the [b]"fully qualified name"[/b] of that column.
[note]This form of writing is especially useful when working with multiple tables that may share the same column names.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Fully Qualified Names[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

In SQL, you can provide the table name prior to the column name, by separating them with a [b]dot[/b].

SELECT [b]customers.[/b]City FROM customers;[/code]
The term for the above-mentioned syntax is called the [b]"fully qualified name"[/b] of that column.
[note]This form of writing is especially useful when working with multiple tables that may share the same column names.[/note]

content.text:
在SQL中，你可以在列名之前提供表名，类似`表名.列名`。

**以下语句是等价的：**
content.text_html:
In SQL, you can provide the table name prior to the column name, by separating them with a dot. The following statements are equivalent:

在SQL中，你可以在列名之前提供表名，用点来分隔它们。 以下语句是等价的：。

content.content:
SELECT City FROM customers;

SELECT customers.City FROM customers;

content.text: 上述语法的称为该列的"**完全限定名**"。
content.text_html:
The term for the above-mentioned syntax is called the "fully qualified name" of that column.

上述语法的术语被称为该列的**"完全合格名称 "**。

content.text: 在处理可能有相同列名的多表查询时，这种写法特别有用。
content.text_html:
This form of writing is especially useful when working with multiple tables that may share the same column names.

在处理可能共享相同列名的多个表时，这种书写形式特别有用。

resolved.title: 排序 Order By
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Order By[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]ORDER BY[/b] is used with SELECT to [b]sort [/b]the returned data. 

The following example sorts our [b]customers [/b]table by the [i]FirstName [/i]column.[code format="sql" codeId="3086"]SELECT * FROM customers
[b]ORDER BY[/b] FirstName;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2800" width="100%"]
As you can see, the rows are ordered [b]alphabetically[/b] by the [b]FirstName[/b] column. [note]By default, the ORDER BY keyword sorts the results in [b]ascending [/b]order.[/note]

content.text:
**ORDER BY**与**SELECT**一起使用时会**排序**返回数据。

下面例子按**FirstName**列对**customers**表进行排序：
content.text_html:
ORDER BY is used with SELECT to **sort **the returned data.

The following example sorts our **customers **table by the *FirstName *column.

ORDER BY*与SELECT一起使用，以排序**返回的数据。

下面的例子按FirstName列对我们的**customers **表进行排序。

content.content:
SELECT * FROM customers
ORDER BY FirstName;

hidden_code_content.prepend_code:
CREATE TABLE customers (
ID      int,
FirstName      VARCHAR(128),
LastName      VARCHAR(128),
City      VARCHAR(128));

INSERT INTO customers (ID, FirstName, LastName, City)

VALUES
( 1,'John','Smith','New York'),
( 2,'David','Williams','Los Angeles'),
( 3,'Chloe','Anderson','Chicago'),
( 4,'Emily','Adams','Houston'),
( 5,'James','Roberts','Philadelphia'),
( 6,'Andrew','Thomas','New York'),
( 7,'Daniel','Harris','New York'),
( 8,'Charlotte','Walker','Chicago'),
( 9,'Samuel','Clark','San Diego'),
( 10,'Anthony','Young','Los Angeles');

content.text: 正如你所看到的，这些行是按**字母顺序**排列的，即按**FirstName**列排序返回的。
content.text_html:
As you can see, the rows are ordered alphabetically by the FirstName column.

正如你所看到的，这些行是按字母顺序排列的，即按名字**列排列。

content.text: 默认情况下，**ORDER BY**关键字将结果按**递增**顺序排序。
content.text_html:
By default, the ORDER BY keyword sorts the results in **ascending **order.

默认情况下，ORDER BY关键字将结果按递增的顺序排序。

resolved.title: 排序多列
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Sorting Multiple Columns[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

ORDER BY can sort retrieved data by multiple columns. When using ORDER BY with more than one column, separate the list of columns to follow ORDER BY with [b]commas[/b]. 
[s0l0!-header]Here is the [b]customers [/b]table, showing the following records:[/s0l0!-header] [img id="2801" width="100%"]
[s0l0!-header]To order by [b]LastName[/b] and [b]Age[/b]:[/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" codeId="3039"]SELECT * FROM customers 
ORDER BY LastName[b],[/b] Age;[/code]
This ORDER BY statement returns the following result: [img id="2802" width="100%"]
As we have two [b]Smith[/b]s, they will be ordered by the [b]Age [/b]column in ascending order.
[note]The ORDER BY command starts ordering in the same sequence as the columns. It will order by the first column listed, then by the second, and so on. [/note]
